distribution.reason: GPLv3 grants present for both repositories. Actual-image/layer licensing, corresponding-source companion and digest-bound source delivery have not completed admission; no commercial license or publication authorization.

constraints: Linux amd64/glibc 2.41 software token, unpatched. Each channel freezes wolfPKCS11 plus its own wolfSSL pairing and ships the dynamically linked /opt/wolfssl/lib closure. No PQC/PKCS#11 v3.2, TPM, ASAN/UBSAN or FIPS variant or assurance claim.

Bind caller-owned writable /var/lib/p11lab; init creates private wolfpkcs11/complete plus native wp11_token_0000000000000001. Object/key files use native wp11_*_0000000000000001_<16-hex-index> names. Native slot 1 is token-present index 0.

Caller-selected SO/user PINs are provisioned by native C_InitToken, C_Login(CKU_SO), C_InitPIN. First init requires both secrets: 4..32 bytes after common single-line parsing, never baked into the image. PIN files are preferred; scalars are supported by the shared contract. Adapter-created child commands receive credentials only through private inherited pipes, not argv, logs, receipts or markers.

P11LAB_LABEL defaults to P11Lab and accepts 1..32 ASCII letters/digits/spaces/dot/underscore/hyphen. Managed WOLFPKCS11_TOKEN_PATH is /var/lib/p11lab/wolfpkcs11; a conflicting override fails before native loading. Raw module users must set their own independent store directory.

Repeated compatible init validates existing state and does not change credentials, including when supplied PIN files change. Scalar/file conflicts still fail. No silent reset, recovery or retry: partial/foreign/linked/busy/unknown state is retained and refused.

Owned directories/files are 0700/0600. Readiness checks exact marker bytes, native metadata framing/label/PIN-set flags and file ownership before real C_Initialize/C_GetTokenInfo/C_Finalize. It is metadata/lifecycle readiness; applications authenticate and independently verify crypto.

exec -- preserves arbitrary argv and exit status after readiness. No provider server/server-ready operation: the module runs in the caller process. Close/finalize and stop all consumers before an explicit caller-owned volume/directory reset.

Serialize readers/writers of each file store, including readiness. Independent clients and shards require independent processes/directories. Upstream file replacement is not cross-file transaction, multi-process isolation or crash-durability qualification.

The small basic runtime contains no checker, Python, compiler, test datasets, tracing, OpenSC/pkcs11-tool or upstream example utilities. Optional installed checker/consumer/proxy derivatives are separate. Remote use requires the compatible pinned proxy daemon/client module and its documented isolation limits.

P-256 generation/signing, persistent key reopen, independent signature verification with altered-message rejection and bounded installed checker/proxy application lanes are qualification targets, not provider-wide certification. Other advertised mechanisms and concurrent/crash/hardware/platform surfaces remain unqualified.

P11Lab selects GPLv3 for wolfPKCS11, wolfSSL and the combined provisioning helper; original adapter sources retain Apache-2.0. Preserve per-file third-party notices and matching corresponding sources/build instructions. Whole-image/runtime base/source-companion/public delivery and optional-derivative rights remain separate unmet distribution gates.
